about.description: Single-stock perpetual market on Ondo Perps tracking Lumentum Holdings Inc., cash-settled, 24/7, up to 10x leverage, margined in USDC, hourly funding. Users get linear price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Adapter snapshot 2026-08-25: mark $862.66, open interest $151.31K, 24h volume $110.30K. Added 2026-08-25 in the second Ondo Perps expansion batch, taking the registry from 35 to 45 RWA markets; the adapter's 50 live rows include 5 crypto perps (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, ONDO) that are out of scope.
